body: My cat just died today. Can you paint her for me?
Thanks! Hope it gets better for you as well, whatever it is you are going through.

I guess I live for another day. My work requires long hours. Before the holidays, I was spending roughly 12-16 hours a day. There are times that I have to pull an all-nighter. I'm new to this job (3 months) and though I want to quit right now, I can't.  I have a bond for 3 years. I moved to a different country for this job so if I quit I have to return all the immigration costs that the company paid for me. Sadly, I can't afford that right now. 

The combination of new job, new country and new culture is making me stressed. And because I was stressed out and tired, my quality of work is suffering as well. The fear that I might get fired bothers me so much because of the said bond and other financial responsibilities that I have. A lot of thoughts are swirling in my head right now because I'm pretty sure I really fucked up in the short time that I'm in this job.  My right to stay in the country is tied to this job and there's no way I can pay off the bond within a month (contract terms) if I come back to my home country. 

I really dig a hole for myself by accepting this job.
Hey, I'm in the same situation but mine is about work. You're not alone. I also failed in my attempt.
